content:
incobot: [ALERT] p99 latency spike for customer QuantumMed (VPC: qm-prod) in us-east-1 — dedicated pool qm-ded-3. p99=2.35s (SLO=0.5s). Triggered 2026-03-17T10:00:45Z

sre-oncall-maya: acked. paging oncall routing, taking lead. investigating root cause now.

eng-runtime-ryan: I see sustained tail latencies on qm-ded-3, token service kernels busy, KV cache miss rate jumped ~3x. Any recent deployments?

platform-sre-jamal: no infra deploys in last 30m. autoscaler didn't kick — pool is at 92% GPU utilization.

netops-alex: network checks look clean for region, packet loss <0.1%. routing stable.

cust-success-tilly: notifying QuantumMed CSM (Sara) that we're aware and working; will prepare a brief with impact windows after we have mitigation.

eng-runtime-ryan: hypothesis: a noisy tenant or request pattern causing KV churn + large context requests. Suggest isolating QuantumMed tenant from qm-ded-3 and moving to warm spare or another pool.

platform-sre-jamal: agree. prepared eviction command. proposal: graceful tenant isolation to new pool, keep prefetched KV where possible.

sre-oncall-maya: plan: (1) throttle new sessions for QuantumMed for 60s, (2) run tenant eviction to warm spare, (3) monitor p95/p99. Callout if p99 not improved in 3m.

eng-runtime-ryan: throttle command: `apictl rate-limit set --tenant quantummed --region us-east-1 --rps 10`

platform-sre-jamal: eviction command (graceful):
```
rinfrctl pool-tenant-evict --from qm-ded-3 --tenant quantummed --to qm-ded-warm-1 --grace 30s
```

netops-alex: routing change ready: will flip traffic for tenant to warm pool using weighted routing to avoid spike.

cust-success-tilly: queued a short customer notice: "We detected elevated latency affecting some requests. We're routing your traffic to a warm capacity to restore performance. Minimal/no data loss expected." Want to send after first verification.

sre-oncall-maya: executing throttle now.

eng-runtime-ryan: throttle in; KV miss rate dropping slightly. initiating eviction now.

platform-sre-jamal: started `pool-tenant-evict` job id job_658901; watching migration. logs: `migrating 32 sessions, warming kv slices`

netops-alex: shifted 40% of traffic to qm-ded-warm-1, 60% still to qm-ded-3. observing metrics.

sre-oncall-maya: p95 improved from 0.9s -> 0.42s, p99 trending down (2.35s -> 0.78s). nice.

eng-runtime-ryan: finished migration. final traffic cutover complete. p99 now 0.48s — within SLO.

cust-success-tilly: sending customer update: "We've routed your traffic to a warm capacity and latency is restored. We'll follow up with postmortem." sending now.

platform-sre-jamal: creating incident ticket and attaching mitigation steps + `job_658901` logs. tagging for post-incident follow-up: runtime team to investigate KV churn root cause, infra to review autoscaler thresholds for dedicated pools.

sre-oncall-maya: monitoring for 30m, then handoff to night oncall. handing off to platform-sre-jamal in 35m. any objections?

eng-runtime-ryan: +1. I'll collect flame graphs and sample payloads (redacted) for the postmortem.

netops-alex: will validate there's no leftover network config change.

cust-success-tilly: customer replied: "Thanks — latency looks normal. Please confirm when root cause known." forwarding to PM and account exec.

sre-oncall-maya: closing active mitigation. follow-up tasks: (a) postmortem draft, (b) evaluate pool autoscaler thresholds, (c) add a targeted alert for KV miss rate per-tenant. assigning owners in ticket.

incobot: Incident acknowledged as mitigated at 2026-03-17T10:08:20Z — severity lowered. Reminder: run postmortem within 48h.

sre-oncall-maya: thanks team. handing off to jamal for monitoring window. will update channel when PMR is ready."
